messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm assembling the 'What's changed' and a short migration blurb for tomorrow's docs push. Draft PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/docs/pull/1204. Can folks confirm any user-facing regressions or clarifications we should call out?

devon: Noted. There's a behavioral change in the Python SDK streaming iterator when you set `max_tokens=None` + `stream=True` — it used to complete the iterator immediately on model end; now we yield an extra empty chunk before close. Filed a small bug: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/sdk/issues/412.

sam: Reproduced. Minimal repro in case it helps for the snippet update:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
for chunk in client.chat.stream(model='kestrel', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'hi'}], max_tokens=None):
    if chunk:
        print(chunk.text)
```
Workaround: check `if chunk.text.strip()` until we patch.

maria: Good catch — I can add a short Known Issue note: "Python streaming may yield an empty trailing chunk; filter empty chunks as a workaround." Where should that live? `docs/releases/known-issues.md` or inline under the SDK notes?

elaine: Put it both places. For the What's changed blurb we should also mention: Dedicated fallback latency increase when autoscaling triggers model variant swap (seen in canary). That's a customer-facing perf caveat. Short line: "Temporary latency increase during autoscale-driven model variant switches."

devon: Also add: embedding dedupe flag changed default from `true` to `false` in the embeddings API v2 — that can affect downstream index size. Link the API spec PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/api/pull/987.

maria: OK — adding three bullets: Python streaming empty chunk, Dedicated autoscale latency blip, embeddings dedupe default change. Anyone want to craft wording for the embeddings note?

sam: Suggest: "Embeddings API v2: `dedupe` default is now `false`. If you relied on automatic deduplication, set `dedupe=true` when creating vectors." Keeps it actionable.

elaine: For the top-of-page banner (marketing wants a short highlight), propose: "Faster routing and smarter rollout controls — rollout can now fallback to compatible variants automatically to reduce errors." Keep it non-technical.

maria: I'll draft both a consumer-friendly banner and a technical release note. Also need to update the Python SDK snippet in `docs/sdk/python/streaming.md` to include the `if chunk.text.strip()` pattern and reference issue #412. I'll push a docs PR with the exact change.

devon: FYI — CI is flaky for the docs build on node 18; I saw broken anchor generation. Filed: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/docs/issues/221. Might delay publish if it doesn't clear, but we can ship the release notes in the site manually if needed.

release-bot: Release window scheduled for 2025-11-04 18:00 UTC. If docs CI is green by +6h, deploy will proceed automatically.

docs-bot: Added checklist comment to PR 1204: update `docs/whats-new.md`, `docs/releases/known-issues.md`, update python snippet, and add changelog entry under `docs/changelog/2025-11-04.md`.

maria: Action items: (1) sam to open a docs PR snippet patch for python streaming (assign @maria for review), (2) devon to link the embeddings API PR and provide exact param name, (3) elaine to approve banner copy, (4) I will update the known-issues and changelog files and merge if CI passes. If CI fails, we'll coordinate manual push. Sound good? :thumbsup:

sam: On it — will push the snippet fix in ~30m and ping here.

devon: I'll paste the exact param details in PR comments.

elaine: Banner copy looks fine from PM side.

maria: Thanks all — closing the loop once PR 1204 lands.
